design.name: terrain_neutral_v4
design.method: Transport donor horizontal velocity into the initial heading throughout recovery; integrate at original timestamps. Retain donor ground clearance over released terrain. Choose translation scale using terrain height changes and footprint roughness.
design.limitation: Designed goal, not an observed or guaranteed feasible trajectory. Full body contacts are tested in IsaacSim.

target.target: Synthetic terrain-aware recovery with zero desired heading change. Actual IsaacSim heading excursion determines whether the motion qualifies as a no-turn comparison.

provenance.schedule_changes: None. Exact lane, costs, physical timing and terminal behavior.
provenance.scope: Single-robot MuJoCo/hardware adaptation; original Isaac batch/DR is not reproduced.
